thread:
Alex P: Quick sync — HyperPrompt asked for a hard SLA for spikes. they want predictable latency during sustained 3x bursts. can we map this into admission heuristics for reserved pools?
Mona: quick thought: allow admission score that factors reserved_headroom, recent_spike_rate, tenant_priority. threshold tweakable per-pool.
Tariq: for oncall we need clear ops handover: when admission drops below 60% for 30s, escalate to pool-owner and enable spill policy. ops-bot: alert created #incident-1234 (link) :rotating_light:
Carmen: propose a simple rule we can ship fast: admit_score = min(1, reserved_headroom_frac * 0.6 + (1 - recent_spike_norm) * 0.4) and fail-open if tenant has emergency flag. pack into a feature-flag rollout.
Alex P: nice. customer asks for "guaranteed tail under burst" — that implies we can't silently preempt them. acceptable trade: soft-spill to <compatible model variant> with 1s added latency. HyperPrompt ok?
Mona: we'll need model-compat mapping and a ranked fallback list per tenant. also metric: p99 latency delta <= 200ms for fallback path.
Tariq: ops playbook draft: 1) alert fires, 2) automated spill to fallback for affected tenants, 3) create ticket with diagnostic snapshot, 4) oncall reviews commit that raised usage, 5) if >15min unresolved, enable temporary capacity-boost (if available). include commands: `rctl pool spill --pool=p-123 --tenant=hyperprompt --target=fallback-v2` and `rctl pool pin --pool=p-123 --headroom=10%`
Carmen: rollout plan: canary the admit_score feature on 5% of traffic (non-committed tenants) -> 25% -> 100% over 3 days. add a kill switch in console.
Alex P: launch criteria for HyperPrompt pilot: 1) admit heuristic in prod on canary, 2) fallback mapping validated with perf tests, 3) SLO/alert thresholds in place, 4) ops-runbook in docs, 5) legal/contract signoff for soft-spill behavior.
Mona: prioritization ask: needs eng-runtime work (admission scoring + fallback routing), eng-platform (console toggle + metrics), eng-sre (alerts + runbook). estimate: 2 sprints if we ship minimal admit_score and fallback router.
Tariq: risk notes: overaggressive admit thresholds can create oscillation. add hysteresis: require sustained breach x seconds and backoff window. also correlate with region-level capacity.
Alex P: decision? we agree to go ahead with minimal heuristic, canary rollout, and ops handover. assign owners: Mona -> runtime impl, Carmen -> console + rollout, Tariq -> runbook & alerts. I'll coordinate customer comms.
Carmen: i'll make the console toggle with immediate revert and record the audit trail. adding a simple UI widget: "admit heuristic: on/off, hysteresis sec, fallback policy"
ops-bot: scheduled a short sync with HyperPrompt CSM next Tue 9am PT.
Alex P: thanks team — I'll update the roadmap card and add these launch criteria to the dedicated-pools epic.
Mona: will open a PR with the admit_score pseudo-config + unit tests today.
Tariq: I'll prep the escalation playbook and a runbook snippet for the oncall runbook repo.
Alex P: ✅ closing action items for now. we'll reconvene after canary metrics come in.
